soldier: Soldier head deep brown tinged with red, pronotum paler, abdomen pale yellow, head capsule rather sparsely haired, the median area of the pronotum with about 20 hairs. Head capsule subrectangular, the sides slightly narrower anteriorly, fontanelle slightly projecting, compound eyes slightly bulging, labrum semicircular. Mandible apices slightly curved; the inner margin of the left mandible smooth with a small tooth below the middle, the right mandible with a small tooth at about the posterior third, the mandibular basal ridge indistinct. Lacinia of the maxilla with about 10 marginal bristles. Antennae 14–15-segmented, segment 1 larger than segment 3. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped notch, the posterior margin shallowly concave at the centre, the median longitudinal line clear.
